coreCommandExpectedReadback.required: Root must independently read actual vitest.json, exact file set/fullName selection and all assertion statuses before claiming retry success. Driver command mode preserves stdout and exit but does not itself parse these cases.

metadataBridge.programSources: No program file is changed by this preparation. Final UI source is still being repaired by root, so this preparation does not certify a metadata-only R5-to-R6 program bridge. Root must inspect actual source delta at execution and preserve any real UI changes explicitly.

singleLoadObservation.interpretation: One current host observation, not evidence that load is the sole cause of any failure. No process was stopped or reprioritized.

retryR6.scheduling: Run only after root freezes the final current source. Do not use --after r5:all-noncompat because it failed; do not overlap with browser/heavy work. retry-core-timeouts command output is explicitly bound to round r6; a later round needs fresh registration.
